checks.name: metadata-draft
pendingGates: Owner-confirmed legal rights/copyright, maintained public support with contact details, private review contacts, price/availability/release method and EU trader status.

Publish the reviewed 5 October 2026 bundled privacy policy at the configured public URL, then verify exact text parity. The public URL currently serves the older 4 October policy; HTTP 200 alone does not satisfy parity.
Obtain or select a valid Mac Installer Distribution identity; export and validate the final App Store package without changing the tested source.
Confirm the com.dabin.mac App Store Connect record, build-number availability, current agreements and required compliance/declaration answers.
Complete signed app runtime acceptance: fresh install and upgrade, real picker/bookmark persistence, clipboard/screenshots consent, external app/browser drops, notifications and quit behavior.
Test minimum macOS14 and the current shipping macOS, accessibility with VoiceOver/keyboard, energy under realistic recording, and optional previews on IPv6-only networking.

Compare current fictional screenshots against the final distribution-signed app; owner confirm artwork rights; upload and process build and metadata only after authorization; Apple review still required.
